# DepartureBoard

> An open-source split-flap departure board for any TV. One `docker compose up` serves the board
> page and a settings page; a small JSON API does everything the settings page does, so your own
> script, automation or agent can put messages on the board and schedule them.

Base URL: the board's own host, e.g. `http://192.168.1.20:8080`. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
on every call except `GET /api/board/current` and `GET /images/{slug}`. The token is printed in the
server log on first boot and shown on `/settings`.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/messages/now` — show text now, above everything else. JSON `{"text": "…"}` or a `text/plain` body.
- `POST /api/messages` — create a message with a schedule: `starts_at`/`ends_at` (ISO-8601 with offset), or `repeat` `daily` with `repeat_start`/`repeat_end` (HH:MM, server timezone), or `repeat` `weekly` with `repeat_days` (Mon 1 … Sun 64, summed) and a time window. `priority` 0–100. `show_seconds` 5–600: how long this message holds the board when equals take turns (null = the display's `rotate_seconds`); `/now` takes it too.
- `GET /api/messages?state=live|scheduled|expired|disabled` — list. `GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/messages/{id}`.
- `POST /api/messages/preview` — how a text lays out on the board; nothing stored.
- `GET/PATCH /api/settings` — `grid_preset` compact (6×22) | large (8×28) | custom (rows 4–10, cols 16–36), `animation` 0–100, `sound_enabled`, `sound_volume`, `theme` (classic-black, walnut, arctic-white, midnight), `idle_text`, `poll_seconds`, `rotate_seconds` (the default slot when equals take turns), `timer_ring` off | own | all (a countdown ring in the board's corner), `background_image` "" | img:<slug> | builtin:terminal|wood|gala|paper with `background_blur` 0–40 px, `background_dim` 0–90 %, `background_fit` cover | contain (a picture behind the board), `cell_radius` 0–12 (% of a cell's width), `cell_gap` 0–100 (hundredths of a vmin), `split_line` 0–3 px (the shape of a flap; 0 / 10 / 0 is Picture mode).
- `POST /api/images` (multipart `file`, optional `slug`), `GET /api/images`, `DELETE /api/images/{slug}` — pictures for `{img:slug}`; `PATCH /api/images/{slug}` `{w 1–36, h 1–10, fit contain|cover|stretch}` sets the block of cells the picture takes (the upload response's `suggested` lists the blocks that keep its shape); `{img:slug@WxH}` sizes it inline; `GET /images/{slug}` is public. `POST /api/images/qr` `{slug, data ≤ 1024}` makes a **QR code** picture (201; the same slug again remakes it → 200): 4×3 cells, **drawn whole** (`solid: true`) so a phone scans it from the sofa — then put `{img:slug}` in a message; two calls, nothing else. `PATCH /api/images/{slug}` `{solid: true|false}` draws any picture whole (no gap or split line through it; a logo too).
- **Guests** — a public phone page that posts a line or a photo into a queue the host approves. `POST /api/guest/rotate` → `{token, url}` opens (or replaces) the guest link `/guest/<token>` (off until then; `PATCH /api/settings {"guest_token": ""}` closes it). `POST /api/guest/qr` makes the picture `{img:guest-qr}` of the link and a disabled `SCAN TO POST A PHOTO` message (409 while off). `GET /api/posts?status=pending|approved|rejected|all` lists the queue; `POST /api/posts/{id}/approve` makes an ordinary message from a post (the words, the photo sized to the rows left, `- NICK`; `source: guest`; `note` when it did not fit and was left disabled); `POST /api/posts/{id}/reject`; `DELETE /api/posts/{id}`; `DELETE /api/posts?status=…` clears (`{removed}`). Settings: `guest_auto_approve` (a post becomes a message at once), `guest_priority` −100–100 (default 1), `guest_show_seconds` 5–600 (default 15). Limits: 120 characters, 16 for a name, 5 MB photos stripped of their metadata, 20 posts an hour per phone, 200 per board.
- **Boards you can switch** — the live board (messages + display settings) saved as a JSON file under the data directory's `profiles/`: `GET /api/profiles` → `[{slug, name, saved_at, messages, pictures_missing, active, changed}]`; `POST /api/profiles/{slug}/save` `{"name": "Party"}` (201 new, 200 overwritten); `POST /api/profiles/{slug}/load` replaces the live board in one transaction (new ids; a message that does not fit the profile's grid is kept disabled — `kept_disabled`; a gone background picture cleared); `POST /api/profiles/{slug}/copy` `{slug, name}`; `PATCH /api/profiles/{slug}` `{name}`; `DELETE /api/profiles/{slug}`; `GET`/`PUT /api/profiles/{slug}` is the file itself (export/import). Every message travels with the board, a `/now` one too; pictures are shared by slug and stay; the guest link is not part of a profile; the read-only setting `active_profile` says which was loaded or saved last. *The party board at 19:00*: `curl -X POST http://board:8080/api/profiles/party/load -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` from cron or an agent step.
- `GET /api/board/current` — what the TV shows: `rows` of cells, `message_id`, `settings`, `stamp` as ETag (`If-None-Match` → 304). Public.
- `GET /api/health` — `{"ok": true, "version": "…"}`.

## Message text

Rows split on newlines, else word-wrap to the board's columns. Uppercased, accents stripped; characters outside A–Z 0–9 `! @ # $ ( ) - + & = ; : ' " % , . / ? °` show as a blank. Token cells, one cell each: `{red}` `{orange}` `{yellow}` `{green}` `{blue}` `{violet}` `{white}` `{black}`, any emoji. `{img:slug}` takes the picture's block (w × h cells, set with `PATCH /api/images/{slug}` or `@WxH`), placed as a word of its own and never cut; the rows beneath a tall block are pushed down. A picture with `solid` (every QR code) is drawn whole over its block, the flaps beneath blank. Capacity is rows × cols; a message that does not fit is a 422 with the reason.
